desc:
🚗 9500 Likes = New Update!

Realistic Vehicle Simulator offers the ultimate driving experience. Get ready to explore stunning landscapes with ultra-realistic cars.

What are you waiting for? Jump in now!

💰 Join Our Group: [https://www.roblox.com/communities/10971563/Shift-Works#!/about]
👥 Follow The Owner: [https://www.roblox.com/users/1109568034/profile/]

🕹️ Controls:
Drive: [W] (Forward) | [S] (Reverse)
Shift Gears: [E] & [Q]
Steering: [W] [A] [S] [D]
Lights: [L]
Flash: [K]
Indicators: [Z] & [C]
Hazard Lights: [X]
Parking Lights: [N]
Free Cam: [Shift + C]
Camera: [V] (Interior) | [V] & [B] (Stabilization)
Mouse Control: [R]
Transmission: [M]


⚠️ Before You Play:
This game is highly detailed. Please ensure you have a fast internet connection and a powerful PC. For better performance, consider playing on a private server to reduce lag.
